hook: A lone firewood cart approaches cathedral guards, suddenly turning into a violent physical ambush within the first few seconds.
cliffhanger: The guards are neutralized, and the loyalists declare the road clear and tell the Duke to proceed.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand a tactical sneak attack on guards; the missing context is why they are attacking, which is answered by the unfolding rebellion.
narrative_context: Alexander's loyal men execute a coordinated infiltration of the cathedral guards to clear the way for his return.
promotional_strength: Provides high-stakes action and sudden physical conflict that grabs attention immediately.

evidence.observation: The cart driver suddenly lunges to tackle the sentry.
Guards lie unconscious as men slip inside the cathedral.

logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide crane shot panning down as a horse-drawn cart loaded with cut firewood pulls up along the wet stone pavement in front of the cathedral steps.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: A lone driver in rugged attire guides the horse cart slowly toward the sentries guarding the arched entryway.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of the royal sentry stepping forward and extending a white-gloved hand to halt the cart.

source_segments.label: ROYAL SENTRY (Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ROYAL SENTRY
source_segments.text: Stop!

source_segments.label: CART DRIVER (Meek, Deferential)
source_segments.speaker: CART DRIVER
source_segments.text: Firewood for the kitchens, sir.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST FIGHTER (Whispering, Cold)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
source_segments.text: Sleep.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

source_segments.label: CART DRIVER (Relieved, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: CART DRIVER
source_segments.text: The road is clear.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST FIGHTER (Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
source_segments.text: Tell the Duke.

hook: Alexander stares into a cracked mirror, immediately cutting away his overgrown beard and hair to reveal his fierce, scarred face.
cliffhanger: Alexander vows to reclaim his house and rescue his wife as he marches forward into the snow, ending on a fierce determination.
standalone_clarity: A classic 'return of the hero' transformation sequence that is universally understandable, showing a rugged outcast reclaiming his noble identity.
narrative_context: Alexander sheds his disguise, puts on his ducal regalia, and prepares to launch his final reclamation and rescue mission.
promotional_strength: High emotional resonance and character transformation, perfect for a revenge and redemption arc.

evidence.observation: Alexander cuts away his hair and beard.
Alexander vows to take back his house and rescue his wife.

logline: While Alexander's loyal men infiltrate and neutralize the royal guards stationed outside the cathedral, Alexander sheds his rugged disguise, dons his ducal regalia, and marches forth to reclaim his house and rescue Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Steely Resolve)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Enough hiding.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Unforgiving)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Today, he comes home.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot through double wooden barn doors opening outward onto a vast, snow-covered landscape as Alexander steps forward into the light.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's hand adjusting the ornate golden lion crest pinned at his cravat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low-angle shot as a loyalist soldier drops down onto one knee before him in the snow.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST (Reverent, Submissive)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST
source_segments.text: Your Grace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up profile of Alexander, his breath pluming in the winter cold, his eyes hardened like steel.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Command)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Secure the chapel.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the soldier rising and snapping a crisp military salute.

source_segments.label: LOYALIST (Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LOYALIST
source_segments.text: Yes, Your Grace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow dramatic tracking shot moving backward in front of Alexander as he strides purposefully through the deep snow, the wooden chapel looming in the distance behind him.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Powerful, Roaring Defiance)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: No more hiding.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Unyielding)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: I am taking back my house.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander marches forward unstoppably, his long coat fluttering in the winter wind as his icy gaze locks forward.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic push-in close-up directly onto Alexander's scarred, fierce face as he speaks with absolute conviction.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Passionate, Unstoppable Vow)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: And I am bringing my wife home.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander's eyes burn with furious determination as the screen cuts sharply to black.
